target: P-completeness of constant-value acquisition for acyclic signed AND2 guard-dependent gate DAGs under t=1
status_proof: KNOWN CVP P-completeness + PROVED/RESTRICTED logspace reduction and verifier upper bounds
model: t one original input fixed to 1; signed negative references, acyclic AND2 definitions, no semantic oracle; signed output root; source grammar checked before evaluation
gate_translation: AND(x,y)=z:(x AND y); OR(x,y)=z:(NOT x AND NOT y), output NOT z; NOT(x) is signed-reference negation; assigned source bits -> t or NOT t
fixed_R: R_mix341 unchanged; theorem is a restriction-evaluation subproblem of its paid signed-AND2 conservative DEF fragment, not a full-R proof-hardness result

resource_upper_bounds.eager: O(M^3) conservative bit steps, O(M) writable bits, where M is entire serialized circuit and annotation output not required
resource_upper_bounds.certificate_checker: with all gate values supplied read-only, O(M^3) bit steps and O(log M) writable bits using repeated source scans
resource_upper_bounds.lazy: O(2^d M^3) bit steps and O(d log M) scratch bits, d maximum gate depth; no memoization; potentially exponential even when eager polynomial
resource_upper_bounds.full_annotation_output: Omega(number of produced bits) output work; not automatically writable space if write-only

falsifiers: one original wire and constant semantic support imply logspace normal-form acquisition: would imply L=P
small signed gate/output type requires only O(1) computation: falsified by uniform CVP reduction
a supplied annotated trace proves all-input SAT correctness: false, proves only local circuit evaluation
an exponential dependency walk count forces exponential actual runtime: false by sharing and eager evaluation
limitations: P-completeness does not prove L != P, a time lower bound for SAT, or a lower bound on all guarded proof converters
source does not assert the full R_mix341 LOCAL-CONVERT grammar supports arbitrary opaque circuits
finite controls are not proofs of the P-completeness reduction
readback: Full GitHub readback verified for report, reproducer, independent referee, coordination handoff and initial raw data (2026-11-03 23:36 PST run).
